findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "set_project_context" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "query" is 1942 chars, far longer than this server's median (171). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "query" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query · Private data: set_project_context, sessions · Public sink: query · Destructive: delete_experiment, query, analytics_funnel, analytics_paths.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query · Private data: set_project_context, sessions · Public sink: query · Destructive: delete_experiment, query, analytics_funnel, analytics_paths

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
